high_level_description: This image is a social media post from the Instagram account @summachar_in, which appears to be discussing the cost of US involvement in two conflicts: Vietnam and Afghanistan. The post includes a title, text, statistics, and an image. The title at the top reads "COST OF US INVOLVEMENT" in bold, orange letters. The text provides context about the US's promises to provide logistical support and military backing to their proxies after withdrawal from both conflicts. It notes that these promises failed in Vietnam but the outcome is still uncertain for Afghanistan.
